_doc: Round 4 LOOKS: the numbers of the elements' looks (ToonFx.looks reads them; the shaders' uniforms are set from here by ToonFx.mat). Looks only: no hitbox, speed, damage or zone radius is here. near: every effect's pixels fade (a screen-door dither, no sorting) from far_m to near_alpha at near_m from the camera (nothing of your own fills your view). own_wall: your own walls and pillars between the camera and your head, or within near_m of the camera, dither to alpha (they still block everything); speed: how fast the fade moves (per s). own_guard: your own Wind Guard's bands drawn band_w as wide, seen from your own camera. range: a bolt's drawn core grows past from_m from the camera up to max times at full_m (its hitbox unchanged). flame: soft edges (soft, in the flame field's units), the domain warp, the tips' embers, the fade where flames meet the deck (deck_fade_m), the fireball's tongues (tongues, each its own phase), the fire wall's flames (count_mult as many at width_mult as wide), the glow underlay's strength. floor_wave: the Kick's three rows (crest, body, trail: their counts, depths behind the front (m) and heights as a share of the crest), fill (how much of a tongue's quad its flame fills: its visible top), the scorch every scorch_every_m fading over scorch_s, sparks thrown ahead, the embers that spill past the lip. smoke: Breath's smoke (a lit volume): its curl (rad over its life), its growth, its tints, its warm under-glow (warm_s from the flame), the deck fade. puffs: a hit's burst on a body stays within body_share of the body's height (body_h_m when it says none; a body within find_r_m of the hit); the puffs between the camera and the struck body drawn at half. air_dust: under an air bolt within over_m of the deck a thin line of dust rises, every every_s. shadow: each bolt's shadow-only core, as a share of its radius by kind. water_gather (the anime pass, 2026-10-16): the water's gather drawn from a source in a ribbon (BendCharge): source_m how far it looks for a grate or puddle, half_w the ribbon's half width at the head over the lock's fill, tail_flare, tip (the head's point share), drawn_start and full_k (how much is drawn at the first frame and by what fill all of it), arch_m, orbit_r and orbit_h (the loop round the body over the fill: its radius and its height; round 2 wider and higher so it clears the body from the player's camera), wave_m and step_hz (the sway, in drawn steps a second), coil_* (the winding on the limb: turns over the fill, its radius), strand_* (the thin strand twisting round it), other_hand (the unused hand's share), ring_every_s (the ripple arcs where it leaves the water: no crown, nothing that reads as a ring on the deck), ahead_m (round 2: a grate before the caster is favoured over one at his back by up to this many metres, so the ribbon is in view of the player's camera), lag_omega, lag_zeta and lag_max_m (round 2: the ribbon's hand end trails the hand about 0.1 s on a spring and overshoots a little, at most lag_max_m), cast_mps and snap (how it is flung at the release).
